classification.difficultyReason: Distinguishes a known share, a total and a difference between shares, then uses the corresponding number of ratio parts.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Alfie and Becky share counters in the ratio $5:3$. Becky receives 12. How many does Alfie receive?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=12\text{ counters}\\1\text{ part}&=12\div3=4\text{ counters}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times4=20\text{ counters}\end{align*}$$
Alfie receives 20 counters.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Alfie and Becky share 32 counters in the ratio $5:3$. How many does Alfie get?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total parts}&=5+3=8\\8\text{ parts}&=32\text{ counters}\\1\text{ part}&=32\div8=4\text{ counters}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times4=20\text{ counters}\end{align*}$$
Alfie gets 20 counters.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Alfie and Becky share counters in the ratio $5:3$. Alfie gets 10 more than Becky. How many does each person have?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Difference in parts}&=5-3=2\\2\text{ parts}&=10\text{ counters}\\1\text{ part}&=10\div2=5\text{ counters}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times5=25\text{ counters}\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times5=15\text{ counters}\end{align*}$$
Alfie has 25 counters and Becky has 15 counters.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Alfie and Becky share counters in the ratio $3:5$. Becky receives 20 more than Alfie. How many are shared in total?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Difference in parts}&=5-3=2\\2\text{ parts}&=20\text{ counters}\\1\text{ part}&=20\div2=10\text{ counters}\\\text{Total parts}&=3+5=8\\8\text{ parts}&=8\times10=80\text{ counters}\end{align*}$$
80 counters are shared in total.
